precursor.role: Transient precursor work; not a runtime or build dependency of blue-electron.

baseline.note: Byte-for-byte import of the reviewed precursor orchestra. Recorded even after subsequent Blue-maintained edits change the current digest.

blueModifications.summary: Blue-maintained header: replaced the precursor generator banner with Blue ownership, provenance pointers, the calibration and release-safety documentation, and the applicable msfa attribution notices.

Added the corpus-wide output calibration giBlueX7OutputCalibration = 0.75, applied at the module output after the per-carrier scale. Established by rendering the default and loudest-voice corpus across all 32 algorithms at velocity 127 (uncalibrated worst peak 1.1892); keeps all corpus renders below the 0dbfs ceiling without per-voice gain.

Live-capable active-note adaptation (Spec 092 US2): bluex7_voice gained kLiveVoice/kLiveMask/kLiveHold inputs. While not held, the UDO re-derives active-note-capable state per control cycle from the live projection (operator frequencies, detune, keyboard scaling, output/velocity sensitivity, envelope rates and levels for current and future stages without replaying completed stages, feedback, LFO speed/delay/depths/wave, pitch-modulation sensitivity, pitch-EG rates and levels, key transpose, live operator mask). Algorithm, oscillator key sync, and LFO key sync remain next-note (captured at note initialization from the transport table). Hold=1 reproduces the previous init-time-only behavior exactly (locked by the unchanged reference render hash).
Extended the public-interface documentation for the new live inputs and the staged whole-voice publication contract.

incorporated.relationship: Lookup tables in the orchestra's giDx7* arrays are transcribed exactly from the msfa sources (velocity curve, keyboard level scaling, EG level LUT, pitch EG rate/level tables, pitch modulation sensitivity table).

reconstructed.relationship: Amplitude-modulation sensitivity values {0, 0.238, 0.461, 1.0} reconstructed as cited in the precursor's implementation report; msfa does not implement AM.

referenceOnly.relationship: Behavioral cross-check of msfa-oriented DX7 behavior; no expression imported.

referenceOnly.project: Russell Pinkston DX7 emulation patches and legacy Blue BlueX7 orchestra (with credits to Jeff Harrington's DX72SCO and JSynthLib)
referenceOnly.relationship: Behavioral reference for the legacy BlueX7 renderer that this module replaces; no expression from these sources is part of the modern module.
